title: Changing the Final Program Counter
statement: For any program, natural number $n$, program counters $p,p'$, initial configuration $c$, and memory function $m$, if $n$ steps take $c$ to the configuration with program counter $p$ and memory $m$, and $p=p'$, then $n$ steps take $c$ to the configuration with program counter $p'$ and memory $m$.
hypotheses_covered: There are $n$ steps of the program from $c$ to the configuration with program counter $p$ and memory $m$
